name: quota-watch
description: The CEO's 93% quota rule: polls every 5 minutes for the whole session and wakes the lead at the threshold, the hold's release, the reset and a reading that stays unknown

name: stall-watch
description: Wakes the lead the moment teammate work stalls: a resource wait over 10 minutes, a live teammate with no commit and no transcript activity for 20 minutes, or a teammate waiting on a slot its own process holds. Looks every 60 s, tells each stall once, and only reports
